_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2012 10-K); 'Recently, new video services and devices have emerged that offer digital distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming, some of which charge a nominal or no fee for access. The success of these new services could negatively impact the demand for our video services, including for our DVR, premium network, On Demand and streaming services'; 'Weak economic conditions in the United States and internationally, including a weak U.S. housing market, persisted during 2012'

classification.quality_note: 'We are a global media and technology company with two primary businesses, Comcast Cable and NBCUniversal' (FY2012 10-K); 'Recently, new video services and devices have emerged that offer digital distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming, some of which charge a nominal or no fee for access. The success of these new services could negatively impact the demand for our video services, including for our DVR, premium network, On Demand and streaming services'; 'Weak economic conditions in the United States and internationally, including a weak U.S. housing market, persisted during 2012'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.28x; +48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.09; conservative 2yr +2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.9%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (FY04-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2014-02-07) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.28x (50.6% downside to Bear $27 / +178.2% upside to Bull $152) | Adj composite 1.65 vs market 1.74: gap -0.09 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +47% above the EPP floor $37 (15x FY14E $2.47) | Conservative 2-yr case: +1.5% total (+0.7%/yr) | At 22.1x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $72 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; video subscribers -1.4% in Q4 2013, forward revenues +6.2% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2013 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
